title: URL to Video AI Generator for Product Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn a public product URL into a short video ad using its product image and name. Create product demos, ecommerce videos, and social ads without a studio shoot.
h1: URL to Video: A Short Ad From a Product Page
lead: AIVideosUGC reads a public product link, keeps the main image and the product name, and makes a short video from them. No shoot and no asset folder to assemble. Pick a size, choose 6 to 30 seconds and download a clip for a listing, a demo or a paid post.
secondary_keywords: turn a link into a video
benefits_h2: Benefits of a URL to Video Ad

benefits.d: Paste a public product page and start from the image and name already on it, so you do not download the photo into a folder first.
The scene shows the feature you name, not every line on the page.
Use the clip as a product demo, an on-page moment or a paid post.

benefits.t: The Price Stays in Your Editor
benefits.d: The link does not bring over prices or reviews. You add those after download.

benefits.t: A Frame and a Length You Pick
benefits.d: Choose a vertical, square or wide frame, plus 4:3 and 3:4, at 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.
A 15-second video uses 60 credits. A failed render returns them. Finished files can be used commercially, with no watermark.

steps_h2: How to Make a Video from a Product URL in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Paste a public product page, confirm the captured image and download the clip.

steps.d: Paste a public product page that opens without a login and shows the variant you sell.
Check the captured image and name. Upload a photo if the page is blocked or has no usable image.
Download the clip, then add your current price or offer in an editor before you post.

maker.cta: Make a video from this link

faq.q: What does a product URL provide?
faq.a: A public page that loads without a login supplies its main product image and name.

faq.q: How do I make a video from a product link?
faq.a: Paste the URL, confirm the image and name, describe the scene, pick a size and length, then download.

faq.q: Can I use a public Shopify or Amazon page?
faq.a: Yes, when the page opens without a login and shows the variant you sell.

faq.q: What if the page requires a login?
faq.a: Upload the product photo directly. The tool cannot read a locked page.

faq.q: Does the URL include prices or reviews?
faq.a: No. Add the current price or a review line in your editor.

faq.q: How many credits does a URL to video clip use?
faq.a: 24 for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. Failed jobs return the credits.

faq.q: Can I reuse the same link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste it again and choose a new scene, opening or length.

faq.q: Can I run the download as an ad?
faq.a: Yes. Finished clips can be used commercially, with no watermark. Check each platform's rules before you scale spend.

faq.q: Is a person in the clip a real customer?
faq.a: No. Any person on screen is AI-generated, not a customer endorsement.

definition.title: What Is URL to Video?
paras: URL to video starts from a public product page instead of a file you download by hand. The tool uses that page's main image and product name as the reference for the clip.

You still choose the scene, the frame and the length. Prices and reviews on the page are not imported. Add the current offer in your editor after download. If a person appears, that person is AI-generated, not a customer.
